subject: DPA / SCCs: hosting split proposal + technical evidence request
messages:
From: Michael Turner <m.turner@novuscare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novuscare.com
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Initial DPA redlines and hosting split question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the call earlier. Attached are Novus Care's initial redlines to Redwood's DPA (Novus_DPA_Redline_v3.docx) and a short SCCs annex we want to confirm. Two items we need clarity on from the ops side before we escalate to legal:

- Hosting split: we propose EU customer data be processed in EU-only dedicated pools (order form option B). Your team mentioned an automatic fallback to hosted-1 for burst capacity — we need to understand the export path for those fallback requests and whether KV caching spans regions.
- Technical evidence: we will need a shortlist of evidence artifacts for our internal privacy team (SOC2 scope snippet, network egress diagram, KMS key custody statement). Can you confirm what you can provide in the next 5 business days?

Elena (copied) will coordinate the redline walk. Please advise who at Redwood is the technical lead for the export-path and caching behaviour.

Best,
Michael Turner
Head of Procurement, Novus Care Solutions

Attachment: Novus_DPA_Redline_v3.docx
Attachment: SCCs_Annex_Novus.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Turner <m.turner@novuscare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines and hosting split question

Hi Michael — thanks for sending these over. Looping in Ben (privacy/legal ops) and Laura (contracts) to coordinate. Quick answers while we triage:

- Hosting fallback: our dedicated EU pools are the default when Order Form option B is selected. For burst capacity we can route to a compatible EU-hosted pool in the same region where possible; if capacity constraints require cross-region fallback we will route only to regions covered by SCCs or an approved transfer addendum. Ben, can you add the canonical fallback routing policy here?
- KV cache: by design our runtime keeps KV caches local to the serving pool to avoid cross-region leakage; ephemeral prefix caching may be shared across replicas in the same region only.
- Evidence: we can provide a SOC 2 scope summary, a redacted network egress diagram, and a KMS custody statement. Laura — would you prefer we upload these to the Drive link or attach to the thread?

We should schedule a short technical walkthrough (30 minutes) between Novus infra and our runtime team to run through exact flows. Proposed slots: Thu 12/17 09:00-11:00 or Fri 12/18 14:00-16:00 CET.

Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Privacy & Contracts — Redwood Inference

Reference: Drive folder for evidence: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cDPA-evidence

From: Elena Popov <e.popov@novuscare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Turner <m.turner@novuscare.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 07:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines and hosting split question

Thanks Sofia — confirming Novus accepts a 30-minute tech walkthrough. We prefer Thu 12/17 10:00 CET (which should line up with your 09:00-11:00 window).

Also, a couple of redline-specific asks from legal:
- Can Redwood accept a carveout in Section 7 for model training/derivative use (we'd like explicit prohibition without prior written consent)?
- SCCs annex: we've annotated Article 46 (appropriate safeguards) with an explicit reference to dedicated pools to ensure the customer's ordering decision is captured formally — please confirm if Redwood will accept that tie to the order form.

Elena
Senior Counsel, Novus Care Solutions

Attachment: SCCs_Annex_Novus.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Popov <e.popov@novuscare.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@novuscare.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 13:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines and hosting split question

Elena / Michael — appreciate the clarity. A few internal notes and proposals after quick review by privacy and runtime: 

1) Model training carveout: we do not perform downstream model training on customer prompts by default. We can accept a clause that prohibits training unless explicitly agreed; operationally we prefer a narrow carveout that allows aggregate telemetry for service improvements (redacted and aggregated). I'll draft suggested wording and share by EOD.

2) Tie to order form / SCCs: we can accept language that ties the applicable hosting boundaries to the Order Form selection. We will not commit to preventing all cross-region fallback in extreme capacity emergencies; instead propose: (a) order form selects primary-region pools; (b) fallback to other SCC-covered regions is permitted only when capacity prevents serving in primary; (c) Redwood will notify customer and log the routed requests in audit logs.

3) Evidence delivery: we'll upload the SOC2 scope PDF, the network egress diagram (redacted), and a KMS custody statement to the Drive folder by tomorrow morning. Please confirm which file names Novus prefers for the evidence binder.

Action items for the walkthrough (Thu 10:00 CET):
- Redwood runtime lead: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com) — walkthrough on routing/fallback and KV caching.
- Novus infra: Michael Turner + Elena Popov — to validate the export-path scenarios and confirm acceptable fallback regions.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference

Attachment: export-path-matrix.xlsx (will be updated during the walkthrough)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Popov <e.popov@novuscare.com>, Michael Turner <m.turner@novuscare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines and hosting split question — post-walkthrough summary and next steps

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today — good session and useful alignment. Summary and concrete next steps: 

- Technical alignment: fallback behavior confirmed — primary EU pool preferred; fallback to EU-hosted compatible pools only; non-EU fallback permitted only under documented capacity emergency with pre-approved emergency-region list (we agreed on DE/UK as potential fallbacks). KV cache remains region-local; no cross-region KV sharing.
- Contract changes proposed: Laura will produce a one-page redline summary that: (a) ties hosting choice to the Order Form; (b) adds an emergency-fallback paragraph with notification + audit-log commitments; (c) includes specific carveout language for model training that allows explicit consent for training and limited aggregated telemetry.
- Evidence delivery: Redwood uploaded SOC2-scope_redwood.pdf, network-egress-redacted.pdf, kms-custody-statement.pdf to the Drive folder (link below). Novus to confirm sufficiency by EOD Mon 12/21.
- Next legal step: Novus to send consolidated DPA redline (single doc) after internal legal review; Redwood to respond with final counter-redline within 3 business days.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cDPA-evidence
Doc sign placeholder (post-agreement): https://app.hellosign.com/s/novus-dpa-sign
Jira ticket for tracking: JIRA-PRIV-5421

If no objections, Laura will upload the redline summary by close of day tomorrow and Ben will prepare the proposed model-training wording.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Manager, Privacy & Contracts — Redwood Inference
